marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Two friends (Madhavan and Sharman Joshi) embark on a quest for a lost buddy. On this journey, they encounter a long forgetten bet, a wedding they must crash, and a funeral that goes impossibly out of control. As they make their way through the perilous lanscape, another journey begins: their inner journey through memory lane and the story of their friend-the irrepressible free-thinker Rancho (Aamir Khan), who in his unique way, touched and changed their lives. It's a story of their hostel days that swings between Rancho's romance with the spirited Pia (Kareena Kapoor), and his clash with and oppressive mentor Viru Sahastrabudhhe (Boman Irani). And then one day, suddenly Rancho vanishes..
